messages:
rachel-sales: Heads-up: Prospect (MediAssist) POC started a heavy demo and is intermittently hitting 429s. Demo sync in 90m, they9re worried.
ben-support: Which endpoints and can you paste a sample 429 response? Any client concurrency numbers?
rachel-sales: Mainly /v1/completions and occasional /v1/embeddings. They run ~25 parallel workers from a CI harness. Sample 429 (redacted):
```json
{
  "error": "rate_limit",
  "type": "per_route_burst",
  "route": "/v1/completions",
  "retry_after": 0,
  "req_id": "ma-202"
}
```
ben-support: Retry-After 0 looks odd (should be >=1). Do they sometimes get responses without Retry-After?
rachel-sales: Yes, a few responses omit Retry-After entirely. They reported flaky behavior.
tariq-eng: Two likely causes: 1) per-route burst limiter tripping due to many concurrent short requests, or 2) short-term token burn rate guard if many tokens are consumed concurrently across routes. Important detail: per-route burst caps and token burn-rate caps are independent.
eli-oncall: I9ll check live tenant counters and SLO charts. Give me 2m.
quota-bot: Fetching tenant counters for tenant=mediassist...
quota-bot: month_commit=1,200,000; month_used=76,000 (6.3%); current_inflight_tokens=9,800; per_route_burst_limit(/v1/completions)=800/min; per_route_rps(/v1/completions)=120
tariq-eng: Inflight tokens ~9.8k with 25 workers and avg response ~150 tokens could produce short token burn spikes. That plus a small per-route burst of 800/min explains bursts of 429s. Missing Retry-After is probably from an early-enforced limiter edge-case; we'll make sure future 429s include a recommended Retry-After.
ben-support: Two remediation options for the demo: a) temporary per-route burst increase for /v1/completions for this tenant, or b) ask the client to reduce concurrency and implement backoff/jitter. For immediate demo safety, presales bump is fastest.
rachel-sales: They want the demo to be rock-solid. Please apply a temporary bump for 3h and we'll notify them it's temporary.
eli-oncall: Applying per-route burst bump to 2400 for 3h now. Quota change id=Q-186210-9.
quota-bot: Change applied: tenant=mediassist, route=/v1/completions, burst=2400, expires=1862110799
ben-support: Also enabling a short token-throughput allowance (+80k tokens/sec) for the window to avoid token-burn 429s. Token change id=TB-186210-3.
quota-bot: Token throughput change applied for tenant=mediassist, delta=80000 tokens/sec, expires=1862110799
tariq-eng: After change, monitor for 10m. Meanwhile, tell the client to: 1) cap client max_concurrency to <=10 for demo, 2) reuse HTTP keep-alive connections, 3) stream responses when expecting >200 tokens, 4) implement exponential backoff with jitter and honor Retry-After when present. Example guidance: "base=0.3s; backoff = min(30s, base * 2**attempt); sleep = random_between(0, backoff)" and if Retry-After provided use max(Retry-After, sleep).
ben-support: I'll send that note and ask for the harness timings to correlate with metrics.
eli-oncall: Monitoring shows 0 429s in last 7 minutes and token burn within temporary allowance.
rachel-sales: Client reran the demo and reports no 429s; they said UI was smooth. I'll open a presales request for sustained capacity if they want to keep this throughput post-POC.
tariq-eng: Long-term recommendations to include in presales: increase sustained per-route RPS for paid tiers, account for token burn in CI harnesses, prefer batching small embedding calls, and implement client-side concurrency controls.
ben-support: Closing this swarm once presales request is filed. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
